body: Audit B-57 (proven by accident, 6 Nov 2026): `python -m encore_server --help` (or any unknown word) starts the server on the live data instead of printing help: __main__.main handles only setup and backup and everything else runs uvicorn. The migrations and the scheduler ran before the port bind failed. Parse the argument: unknown words print the commands and exit non-zero. docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-57.
